root_cause.text: The root cause is the omission of `cdns_drd_gadget_off()` in the error path of `__cdns3_gadget_init()` when `cdns3_gadget_start()` fails, resulting in a hardware/software state inconsistency where the DRD hardware remains in gadget mode while the software state stays INACTIVE.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the addition of `cdns_drd_gadget_off(cdns);` inside the `if (ret)` block following `cdns3_gadget_start(cdns)` in `drivers/usb/cdns3/cdns3-gadget.c`, and the CVE description explicitly states that this failure to clean up leaves the hardware in gadget mode while software state remains INACTIVE
